title: Relationships between systemic sclerosis and atherosclerosis: screening for mitochondria-related biomarkers.
authors: Wang, Fei; Lyu, Xiao Yan; Qin, Yi Ming; Xie, Mei Juan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组筛选系统性硬化症与动脉粥样硬化相关的线粒体生物标志物，仅预测了转录因子而未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Patients with systemic sclerosis (SSc) are known to have higher incidence of atherosclerosis (AS). Mitochondrial injuries in SSc can cause endothelial dysfunction, leading to AS; thus, mitochondria appear to be hubs linking SSc to AS. This study aimed to identify the mitochondria-related biomarkers of SSc and AS. METHODS: We identified common differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in the SSc (GSE58095) and AS (GSE100927) datasets of the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Considering the intersection between genes with identical expression trends and mitochondrial genes, we used the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) as well as random forest (RF) algorithms to identify four mitochondria-related hub genes. Diagnostic nomograms were then constructed to predict the likelihood of SSc and AS. Next, we used the CIBERSORT algorithm to evaluate immune infiltration in both disorders, predicted the transcription factors for the hub genes, and validated these genes for the two datasets. RESULTS: A total of 112 genes and 13 mitochondria-related genes were identified; these genes were then significantly enriched for macrophage differentiation, collagen-containing extracellular matrix, collagen binding, antigen processing and presentation, leukocyte transendothelial migration, and apoptosis. Four mitochondria-related hub DEGs (IFI6, FSCN1, GAL, and SGCA) were also identified. The nomograms showed good diagnostic values for GSE58095 (area under the curve (AUC) = 0.903) and GSE100927 (AUC = 0.904). Further, memory B cells, gammadeltaT cells, M0 macrophages, and activated mast cells were significantly higher in AS, while the resting memory CD4(+) T cells were lower and M1 macrophages were higher in SSc; all of these were closely linked to multiple immune cells. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) showed that IFI6 and FSCN1 were involved in immune-related pathways in both AS and SSc; GAL and SGCA are related to mitochondrial metabolism pathways in both SSc and AS. Twenty transcription factors (TFs) were predicted, where two TFs, namely BRCA1 and PPARgamma, were highly expressed in both SSc and AS. CONCLUSION: Four mitochondria-related biomarkers were identified in both SSc and AS, which have high diagnostic value and are associated with immune cell infiltration in both disorders. Hence, this study provides new insights into the pathological mechanisms underlying SSc and AS. The specific roles and action mechanisms of these genes require further clinical validation in SSc patients with AS.
abstract_zh: 背景：已知系统性硬化症（SSc）患者动脉粥样硬化（AS）的发病率较高。SSc中的线粒体损伤可导致内皮功能障碍，进而引发AS；因此，线粒体似乎是连接SSc与AS的关键枢纽。本研究旨在识别SSc和AS的线粒体相关生物标志物。方法：我们在基因表达综合（GEO）数据库的SSc（GSE58095）和AS（GSE100927）数据集中识别了共同的差异表达基因（DEGs）。考虑到表达趋势相同的基因与线粒体基因之间的交集，我们使用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）以及随机森林（RF）算法识别了四个线粒体相关枢纽基因。随后构建了诊断列线图以预测SSc和AS的可能性。接下来，我们使用CIBERSORT算法评估两种疾病中的免疫浸润，预测枢纽基因的转录因子，并在两个数据集中验证这些基因。结果：共识别出112个基因和13个线粒体相关基因；这些基因显著富集于巨噬细胞分化、含胶原的细胞外基质、胶原结合、抗原加工与呈递、白细胞跨内皮迁移及凋亡等通路。还识别出四个线粒体相关枢纽DEGs（IFI6、FSCN1、GAL和SGCA）。列线图在GSE58095（曲线下面积（AUC）= 0.903）和GSE100927（AUC = 0.904）中显示出良好的诊断价值。此外，记忆B细胞、γδT细胞、M0巨噬细胞和活化肥大细胞在AS中显著升高，而静息记忆CD4(+) T细胞在SSc中较低，M1巨噬细胞在SSc中较高；所有这些均与多种免疫细胞密切相关。基因集富集分析（GSEA）显示，IFI6和FSCN1在AS和SSc中均参与免疫相关通路；GAL和SGCA在SSc和AS中均与线粒体代谢通路相关。预测了二十个转录因子（TFs），其中两个TFs，即BRCA1和PPARγ，在SSc和AS中均高表达。结论：在SSc和AS中识别出四个线粒体相关生物标志物，这些标志物具有较高的诊断价值，并与两种疾病中的免疫细胞浸润相关。因此，本研究为SSc和AS的病理机制提供了新的见解。这些基因的具体作用和机制需在伴有AS的SSc患者中进行进一步的临床验证。
